definition: The process of annotating raw data with the correct outputs, categories, or attributes needed for supervised training or evaluation.
details: Data labeling can be performed by human annotators, crowdsourcing platforms, or increasingly by other AI models, and its quality and consistency directly impact downstream model performance.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. Boil it down and it is this: The process of annotating raw data with the correct outputs, categories, or attributes needed for supervised training or evaluation. Here is why it matters: Data labeling can be performed by human annotators, crowdsourcing platforms, or increasingly by other AI models, and its quality and consistency directly impact downstream model performance. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. That care with the raw material is Data Labeling.
